Claude private chat in 3 steps: incognito, no memory. Not saved to history or memory.

1. New Chat - Start a new chat, outside any project.
2. Ghost - Click the ghost icon at the top right.
3. Ask - Look for the Incognito chat label, then ask. Still kept 30 days by default.
